name: agent-perform
description: A Claude Mod above the Claude Code prompt that keeps your context spending in check and builds good habits: live context use, a Cache countdown, this turn's context growth, quota use, warning colours past thresholds, and one-click /clear, /compact and /recap once context passes 30%. Comes with a large local dashboard at localhost:8787 that drills into every conversation and turn to find where tokens were spent abnormally.

autoCompact.title: Auto compact with recap after an idle hour
autoCompact.description: When the context is at 60% or more and the session has been idle for an hour, run /recap and compact with it. Off by default.
